hero.title: Hear less. Guess faster.
hero.body: Each round opens more of the song, from 2 to 30 seconds. The earlier you guess, the more you score.

ladder.label: The five listening levels of a round
ladder.caption: Base score for guessing right at each level. The shorter the clip, the more you score.

solo.title: Solo play
solo.description: Just you and the music you pick. In a match within a few taps.

daily.title: Daily challenge
daily.description: One shared song a day for everyone.

quick.title: Quick match
quick.description: Join a public room that fits the music you like.

how.heading: How a round works

listen.title: Hear the first 2 seconds.
listen.body: Each round opens a very short clip. Replay it as often as you like.

more.title: Not yet? Hear more.
more.body: Tapping hear more, or a wrong guess, opens the next level: 5, 10, 20, then 30 seconds.

guess.title: Type the song title.
guess.body: Suggestions appear as you type, and typing without accents works too.

score.title: Sooner means more points.
score.body: Right at 2 seconds is worth 1,000 points, and every level after takes off 200.

how.figure: points for a right guess at the 2-second mark.
